question.text: Under Rule 9 of the PML Rules, what is the beneficial ownership threshold for an unincorporated association or body of individuals?

answer.text: More than 10 percent of property, capital, or profits
More than 15 percent of property, capital, or profits
More than 20 percent of property, capital, or profits
More than 25 percent of property, capital, or profits

explanation.text: The Logic: For an unincorporated association or body of individuals, the beneficial owner is the natural person(s) having ownership of or entitlement to more than 15 percent of the property, capital, or profits. The Trap: The 10, 20, and 25 percent thresholds apply to different entity types or other regulatory regimes; the unincorporated-association rule specifically uses 15 percent. Note: The 15 percent figure is specific to unincorporated associations or bodies of individuals.
